summary: Iteration-2 regression + new-feature pass. Extended backend_test.py from 27 to 41 pytest cases covering ALL new §-items (3,4,7,22,10,16-20,1,2,14): cutoff validacao_sku, physical enrichment (incl. 'SKU fora do sistema'), pendencia-tabs base+gatilhos, PUT /records moves rows between base→gatilho, DELETE /inventories/{id} with permission (403 for user, cascade for admin), created_by on inventory, PUT /users/{uid} (incl. cross-company 404), PUT /auth/profile foto, global /pendencias search + /classificacoes + gatilho filter, Excel export with 'Concluído Por' column, plus full regression of iteration-1 suite. 41/41 passed when run serially (-n 0). Note: when run with the project default -n 2 --dist loadscope, 6 tests that depend on fixtures mutated by TestInventory failed because they land on a different xdist worker. Frontend Playwright smoke test as company_admin covered: dashboard module-card-inventario → access-module-inventario → inventory list → inv-card-<id> → delete dialog (open+cancel) → inv detail with KPIs/donut → Pendencias (pend-search, pend-classif-filter visible, status select, 0 search hits for 'SKU' — see note) → topbar-profile-btn → profile-upload-btn → Users create → edit-user dialog (nome/funcao/senha/active/foto) → edit-user-save. All target data-testids present and wired.

minor.issue: Search haystack includes item['status'] (= resolucao_status, e.g. 'Pendente') but NOT item['status_inventario'] (e.g. 'SKU FALTANTE'). Users searching 'SKU FALTANTE' or 'faltante' get 0 hits. Per spec §19 search must cover 'status'. Low risk — PT 'status' is ambiguous — but recommend including status_inventario in the search blob.

Default addopts '-n 2 --dist loadscope' puts classes on independent xdist workers that each build their own module-scoped company_ctx/admin_session; new feature tests that need company_ctx['iid'] created by TestInventory then fail with KeyError. Serial run (-n 0) is clean. Options: (a) move inventory bootstrap into a session-scoped fixture, (b) pin new classes to the same scope as TestInventory, or (c) convert ctx mutations into independent fixtures. Not a product bug but blocks the configured parallel run.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1158 lines — still above the 700-line split guideline; please extract routers (auth, companies, users, cadastros, inventory, reports, pendencias).

_process_validation uses raw str(c.get('peso',0)) in physical enrichment but defaults peso to the literal string 'SKU fora do sistema' for fora rows — downstream numeric consumers (resumo material, charts) must handle a str-or-number field. Consider storing peso=0 + a flag instead.

update_record sets concluido_por to user.get('nome') (display name). If two users share a name within a company (allowed, no unique constraint), auditability suffers — consider also storing concluido_por_username.
global_pendencias loads up to 5000 records then filters in-process; for large tenants push 'search' into a Mongo text/regex query to avoid O(n) scans per request.
DELETE /companies/{cid} runs 4 collection-level delete_many({'company_id': cid}) then another identical block for inv_ids — redundant (safe but noisy); remove the duplicated loop.
